_comment: Shadow Spears — WH40K cyber-monastic dataslate (the owner's chapter). Mauve heraldry accent over the base Catppuccin palette (NOT hand-rolled — only the accent, a palette name, changes). Angular gothic framing, purity-seal corner brackets, a warm parchment/dataslate grain, and weightier 'ritual' motion. WH40K elements kept restrained per STYLE_GUIDE. See docs/THEME_PACK.md.
_palette_note: Deliberate grimdark pack palette (NOT the Catppuccin base) — bone/umber/near-black materiality with amethyst (Shadow Spears heraldry) + aged-gold trim. Packs may carry their own scheme where the base's modern palette is off-identity.
_font_note: displayFamily is a stand-in serif (installed); drop a gothic/blackletter OFL face in fonts/ + set font.displayFile to ship a real one. Body text stays the mono base for legibility.
